title: Phenomenology of an Open Effective Field Theory of Dark Energy
summary: All observational evidence for dark matter and dark energy is so far exclusively gravitational. Hence, the dark sector may be equivalently described by a theory of the spacetime metric whose dynamics is affected by interactions with an unknown environment. Adapting open-system techniques, we have recently constructed such a general theory of open gravitational dynamics. Here we study a minimal and concrete realization of this theory that describes the late-time acceleration of the Universe. Our model provides a good fit to recent baryon acoustic oscillation measurements by construction,…
